reading_problem: search enumerates the fuel x state product and repeats each terminal state for zero and successor fuel; this obscures the fact that only Searching consumes fuel.
author_taste_hypothesis: Terminal states should each have one visibly fuel-independent return, followed by the two pending-state cases. A small case grammar may improve compression and delight, but preserving visible stopping cases is more important than shorter code. This is author judgment, not recorded user preference.
user_preference: User requested three independent style targets; no preference for this candidate has been obtained.

gate_plan: Run existing harness gates/mutations/scaling with BUILD and RECEIPTS redirected after import; no historical outputs overwritten. Freeze extra zero-fuel/store probe before candidate. Compare same-machine baseline and candidate benchmark timings without treating timing as proof.
